sense.text:
Kill or be killed is not about carnal weapons; the only thing to pick up is the Bible. Either you kill the old man inside you, the one that still reigns in your members and always wants to rise to the top and control you, or you will be killed serving that dead man, perishing here in Babylon the Great when judgment comes. Choose ye this day.

“And ye shall know the truth.” That ye is not the whole world, not the white man, not the Hamite. It is the Israelites, the 12 tribes, who shall know the truth.

“And the truth shall make you free.” Free from the oppressive state, from the mentality many still hang on to even inside these doors, from Christmas, Halloween, Mother’s Day and white Jesus, from the hard bondage and the spiritual warfare we serve. The truth is our weapon. It is why the Bishop tells you to read your four chapters a day, to become acclimated to this glorious gospel and our glorious history. Many cast it to the side and stay in their sin rather than cleanse their temple with the word of God.

This Bible is a weapon of mass destruction. It defeats all opposition we face day to day in our captivity, and as the word goes out the angels are being activated. Deacon Abiel made the point that in his time coming into the truth you never heard of the earth being shaken up the way it is now: as these pages turn and the prophets are back on the corners, time is speeding up and the age of decadence is right around the corner. Bishops and Deacons with aching bodies and arthritis are out there wielding this weapon, tearing down the strongholds that plague our people, while many brothers would rather sit and scratch.

It says the truth “shall”, not might. But you must study, pray and apply to unlock this weapon, so the spirit of the Lord can come upon you and you know how to wield the sword. It destroys not only the other nations but the inward man you still battle. A brother can learn to pick up a Glock 17 and sell drugs, but can’t stay awake through four chapters a day; then when correction comes he is offended and out the door, because he was never rooted and it was a boys’ club to him. The truth is what unshackles the spiritual chains on our brains, and it is happening at an alarming rate across the planet.

precepts.why:
“Thy righteousness is an everlasting righteousness.” The Lord’s righteousness will not cease, and with it comes the kingdom.

“And thy law is the truth.” The laws and commandments of our heavenly Father are the truth. That is the truth John 8:32 speaks of. There is nothing else on the face of the planet that holds truth except the Bible, the commandments of God. Hermeneutics doesn’t do it, the damn Trinity doesn’t do it, you damn scoffers online don’t have the answers. It is the laws of God that have the truth, and it is that truth that makes the 12 tribes free.

How do you activate the weapon of the truth? How do you get in the spirit? There is a key to it, a mystery the Most High gave only to his prophets, and the prophets and the daughters of Sarah are sitting in this room, though many don’t see themselves that way. The key is “Examine yourselves, whether ye be in the faith; prove your own selves.”

You must know yourself to depose the enemy within. Only you know what you are dealing with. You can’t ask the Deacons or the Bishops what they see in you; you have to know your own hang-ups, shortcomings and battles. Many deny them and keep a place of comfort for that spirit. The enemy within you is the biggest adversary, more deadly than any nation round about. You are the first enemy. You have to subdue what is inside you, and walk in order with the law, statutes and commandments, before the Father endows you with wisdom, knowledge and understanding, and before you can even gauge spiritually what the other nations are up to. It starts at home, because many walk in league with the enemy, and have done worse than the enemy.

“Prove your own selves”: be honest with yourself. That ties back to John 8:32: not only is the law the truth, you must be truthful with yourself to unchain the things that plague you. Brothers and sisters say they are good while playing with legions of demons, instead of asking the Lord to guide them through the scriptures, or going to the leadership or a senior sister and saying, I need help, I’m battling this. Many refuse to kill and allow themselves to be killed, just going through the motions until the Lord takes the light away and they end up in the street, incarcerated, or dead.

“Know ye not your own selves, how that Jesus Christ is in you”: his laws resonate in you, you keep the commandments, “except ye be reprobates.” That is the stage of brothers here eight, nine, ten years who now preach the flat earth, that all can be saved, and a Trinity. They may know how to break down a scripture, but slowly the Lord strips the wisdom and understanding from them and they don’t even see themselves being pushed out the doors, because they were not truthful first with themselves. You don’t prove this walk to us; you prove it to Christ. You broke bread. This is not a social club. It is life or death.

Knowing your enemy deeply is how total victory is won: an uncompromising force beyond what the enemy expects. For 15, 20, 25 years you walked the street as a stick-up kid or a drug dealer, and some sisters were prostitutes. That old man or old woman never expects you to come with the laws of God, applying the scriptures day in and day out, fasting and praying to remove these spirits. The Lord may leave a spirit there to keep you in remembrance, as Paul’s thorn in the side, but Christ said by praying and fasting these things are purged. You must crush the old man within, outmaneuver him and take away his capacity to retaliate, by the weapons you bring, by being among the brothers and sisters and learned, seasoned men, asking questions. The fight is within you.

sense.text:
This is a major hang-up that keeps fuelling the enemy inside. “A wise man will fear in every thing”: the Bible is written in the masculine, but it is the wise brother or sister who applies the commandments. That wise man fears the judgment of the heavenly Father.

“And in the day of sinning he will beware of offence”: he will not transgress the laws of God, and he will beware of letting that old man dwell and have dominion over him. There is a conscience here. In the world we had none: steal that, sleep with her and her friend, take somebody’s car, with no thought of AIDS or jail behind it. Now in this truth you understand the judgments of the Lord and that he is not playing.

Yet many still tempt the Father, thinking he will let it slide, until he gives you the monster, until you get AIDS, until you get locked up. Many hard-headed brothers and sisters have been given counsel, and it is not our counsel but the Lord’s, and they went against it. Then the Father takes off his belt: a slow death or a fast one, incarceration, or a warrant waiting for you on the side of the road. The Lord is the king of terrors.

precepts.why:
Why does the wise man fear? “The fear of the Lord is to hate evil”: not to indulge in it, but to despise and loathe evil and everything that comes with the package of evil, and to purge it from inside you.

“Pride”: pride is evil in the eyesight of the Lord, and many of us carry it. You can’t tell me nothing, I’m older than you. Sisters who say they want an older sister over them, brothers who want an older brother over them. The Lord sent these people and put them in your life. Where the one over you has no children, the leadership pairs you with someone who can guide you with yours, because not all of us were good parents, but the Lord has those offices covered. You learn something every day you wake up on this planet.

“And arrogancy”: you can’t stand being corrected for your own benefit; you get emotional and leave out the doors saying you know everything. Then you are saying God can’t tell you nothing, so why are you here?

“And the evil way, and the froward mouth”: the disrespectful, childlike, churlish mouth. Many sisters carry that spirit toward new sisters, and some brothers too, until new members don’t want to come back because you are nasty. You must soften, remove that man spirit, have a charitable spirit, and kill the old man and the old woman you were taught in the world. The Lord said whoever offends one of his little ones, better a millstone were upon his neck. Push people out the door and you have a judgment coming.

“Do I hate.” God despises a negro like that; he says, get it away from me. So we must know ourselves: does this resist me? Do a checkup from the neck up. Write it on the mirror with a Sharpie: I deal with pride, arrogancy, an evil eye toward my brothers and sisters. Activate the weapon, read your four chapters a day, and do your due diligence to be deemed worthy of the kingdom, because you will not stand before the Lord with three or four others; you give account for you in that day.

sense.text: “Go not after thy lusts, but refrain thyself from thine appetites.” Lust is one of the key things that jams us up as a nation of people. The enemy within us all must be killed by not giving in to the temptations of the flesh. Everybody here deals with lust and the covetous spirit, and you must control it. Is it all right to have things? Yes. But brothers and sisters take it to the extreme behind their lust and end up jacked up. Be content with what you have.

“If thou givest thy soul the desires that please her”: I have to be rich, I’m not content, I’m just trying to get a bag, money is my god. Then “she will make thee a laughingstock to thine enemies that malign thee.” To malign is to smear your name and speak evil of you.

A brother asked counsel about a certain purchase he lusted after. Leadership laid it out with the word of God; Captain Barnabas told him not to do it, that it would pull him out from the work. He went and got it anyway, and the thing turned out to be stolen. The cops got in the midst of it; by the Lord’s mercy they let him go because he had been scammed, and he was burned out of the money he put toward that desire. Had he been locked up, the other nations who know he is with IUIC would have laughed: you were supposed to be righteous. That is the laughingstock the verse speaks of.

“Take not pleasure in much good cheer, neither be tied to the expence thereof.” Don’t chase your lust; you may be discredited by it or incarcerated by it. Not everything is for everybody. A brother says he can just work a couple more hours, and then he is never in the congregation, working so much that Christ sneaks up on him and he is out there in the dark when the destruction comes, cut off from the kingdom because he put his lust before the works of the Lord.

The carnal man seeks after these things. The spiritual man says, I’m content with what I have, Lord, thank you for everything you have given me. Not the negro who has to be like Lil Wayne, with the big flashy chain and the biggest house. Brothers will hurt themselves going after their lust.

Examine yourself: do I have that lustful spirit? Do I desire more than I need? “From whence come wars and fightings among you? come they not hence, even of your lusts that war in your members?” The wars and fightings among you manifest from your lusts, a constant battle between the spiritual man and the carnal man.

Many brothers deal heavily with porn, desensitizing themselves until it will be curtains for them even when they marry. How can you waste royal seed that is here to bring forth and build back a nation, sitting there aroused watching another man with a sister, tapes of things actors do, then shooting off in a napkin or the drain and crying, oh gosh, I feel so convicted, Deacons and Captains, I was playing with my tally whacker. Our brothers have got to come out of that. You have to kill that old man.

“Ye lust, and have not”: you lust after things but don’t obtain them. “Ye kill, and desire to have, and cannot obtain”: you slander a brother or sister who has what you want, give them the evil eye, speak nasty about them, say they must be doing some dirt. That is the mentality of brothers and sisters, the spirit inside thyself. “Ye fight and war, yet ye have not, because ye ask not.”

“Ye ask, and receive not”: a home, a car, even a wife. God is not against marriage; marriage is honorable. Yet some brothers slander another brother because the sister they wanted to prove is not interested, when they show they don’t have their stuff together. “Because ye ask amiss”: for the wrong reasons, to stunt in front of brothers and sisters who don’t have, to have a trophy wife with not a hill of beans of understanding in her brain. “That ye may consume it upon your lusts.” Of course the Lord knows you need a house to cover shame, a wife if you burn, transportation. But you asked to be the HNIC, to be seen of men, not in sincerity that his will be done and he be magnified and glorified through it.

“Ye adulterers and adulteresses”: when you go contrary to the laws of God and these other things become a god to you, you have committed adultery on the heavenly Father. Kill that adulterous spirit.

“Know ye not that the friendship of the world is enmity with God?” Loving this society and this captivity is hatred against the heavenly Father and his Son Jesus the Christ. Brothers go above and beyond to keep this captivity going instead of helping bring it down through the word of God and waking up the 12 tribes. You love the place, the oppression of your brothers and sisters, the census killings, the ICE raids, as long as you can pull up to camp in your new Range Rover. God doesn’t give a damn about that Range. He is going to blow your ass; when the kingdom comes and he drops that nuclear bomb on that ass, it is going to be ranging then.

“Whosoever therefore will be a friend of the world is the enemy of God.” You have deemed yourself the enemy of God. Some of our mindsets are worse than the other nations: by any means you will take your brother out for what he has, by any means be part of this wicked society. Some sneak off to big mama’s house on Christmas and leave with fifteen presents in the trunk, saying they won’t open them till the 27th. Come the 25th, New Year’s Eve, Thanksgiving and Halloween, there will be empty seats, because they cannot shake this world and are not ready to kill the old mentality. If they keep playing, the Lord will take them out. Either you kill or you will be killed.

“The spirit that dwelleth in us lusteth to envy.” Many still have an affinity for the world. Everything in this society is built on lust; everything as far as the eye can see appeals to the flesh, I got to have, I got to have. Those who have travelled know you don’t see that in other countries, but in Babylon everything is at your fingertips, and it plays with you.

“God resisteth the proud”: the Lord hates the spirit of a proud brother or a proud sister, as Proverbs 8:13 says. “But giveth grace unto the humble”: he gives time to the humble, those who fear him and keep his commandments faithfully. You don’t have to ask them to be here or to volunteer; they despise the place where they get their pecuniary compensation, and there is no better comfort to them than being among believing brothers and sisters.

The Lord gives them a grace period to get themselves right and be chosen for the kingdom. They are sharpening their swords to subdue the evil spirit that plagued them for years before this glorious gospel. This is a hospital; don’t run from it. All of us are working on something, all of us sharpening the sword to kill the old man or woman, and all we have is each other. You can’t get that from a white man’s couch or from cashing a check. Pay all the bills and you will still feel empty without the Lord.

“Submit yourselves therefore to God”: to his will, his law, statutes and commandments. “Resist the devil”: devil means deceiver. Resist the treachery, the lies, the Trinity, the apologetics, the other nations and their false doctrines, the world, point blank, period.

“And he will flee from you.” You see that brother building up in the truth because he resists the tricks of the deceiver and is cut off from their holidays, their doctrines, their sorcery and their education that is all lies. He now knows who he is and there is no room for Satan. Satan may depart for a season, but he always comes back; he is very cunning. Keep a straight path, veer neither left nor right, fight, and the Lord will fight for you.

“Draw nigh to God”: be here, be in the circles, give your time. “And he will draw nigh to you”: he will reveal himself and open his understanding to you, the dark mysteries and the parables, so you can guide your household and meet every temptation with thus saith the Lord, and reach out to the officers over you when you can’t. Those who won’t come up to the table, or sit way in the back when leadership teaches, are not drawing near to the Lord either. They are waiting for the wine table at the new moon. It is a commandment to blow the shofar at the new moon, yet brothers come in with three-hundred-dollar bottles and no shofar. Examine yourself: you might be an alcoholic. Do you believe this, or are you here for the bottle and the mirth? That is another spirit to kill.

“Cleanse your hands, ye sinners”: of your evil works and ways. “And purify your hearts”: your minds. “Ye double minded”: one foot in and one foot out the door. The Lord would rather you were cold or hot; the lukewarm he will spew out, and that means he will put you to death. Either you are hot and kill the old man, or you are lukewarm and put to death. Somebody has to die. Tomorrow is not promised, so stop playing with the heavenly Father and remove far from you the old worldly mindset.

precepts.why:
For all you chicken chokers out there: kill that old man. “The nation of Israel, the princes, the priests and Levites, have not put away from them the strange people of the land, nor the pollutions of the Gentiles”: the Israelites had not removed themselves from the heathen. It is like that today; the next pollution of the Gentiles is evil ass Christmas. The Canaanites, Hittites, Pheresites, Jebusites, Moabites and Egyptians are the nations of today: the Africans, the Chinese, the Hamites and the white men.

“For both they and their sons have married with their daughters, and the holy seed is mixed with the strange people of the land.” The kings and priests had intermingled with the nations’ daughters. What is the sperm that comes from a brother? The holy seed. So brothers whacking off are spewing holy seed that could have been a prophet, an avenger: had it been your son, it was an avenger coming back to put in his brick. Through a righteous marriage you could impregnate your wife and bring him forth, but you shot your son in a sock, down the drain, in a damn trash can with your nasty ass. You say, I’m a nasty negro, and you can’t stop. Better come out of that foolishness and kill that old man before you are killed.

The same is for brothers who cannot kill the old man that has an affinity for the white woman, the Chang Wang booty, the pancake flat Japanese or Moabite chick, the dusty Arab chick, like Russell Simmons and Kimora Lee; these are heathens. The same is for brothers secretly dealing with prostitutes and escorts. Either you kill the old man within or you catch an STD and are killed by the judgment of the Lord. The Most High may plague you so your Johnson never works again after a stroke. Keep rolling the dice and you might crap out. This is the lust that wars in your members.

“Because sentence against an evil work is not executed speedily”: the judgment of the Lord for the ill-doings brothers and sisters do in the dark, outside this congregation, does not fall immediately. “Therefore the heart of the sons of men is fully set in them to do evil”: the heart is the mind, and the mind is set to do it over and over again.

Things lie dormant. The Most High is the king of terrors. He may let it manifest, bubble and marinate in you, and then say: this brother or sister gives not a damn about my laws; I showed mercy and longsuffering, now I execute them. I’mma get your ass either one way or the next. A slow death: AIDS, HIV, gonorrhea, syphilis. I gave you a chance to repent and you were hard-headed, and a hard head makes a soft ass. Then you cry out to God, and God is not hearing you; he is mocking you.

If you love the world you hate Christ. “Love not the world, neither the things that are in the world”: love not this captivity, its precious things and riches, the mansion on the hill, not even your job. Many love their jobs more than this truth. These things are hooks inside you that will pull you out of this truth faster than you know. They are devices of Satan, the tangible trinkets he gives our brothers and sisters to lust after as status symbols, when the kingdom of heaven is at hand.

“If any man love the world, the love of the Father is not in him.” That is why to love the world is enmity against God: you hate God. Enmity is the state of being actively opposed or hostile to someone: animosity, friction, rivalry, feud, conflict, discord, acrimony, bitterness, resentment. That is the mind that says, why do I have to keep the Sabbath, I could be home, the fight is on today, but I don’t want to look bad in front of the brothers and sisters. That is hating God, his laws and his will.

This world, this captivity, this dominion of your oppressor is going to go, and if you don’t kill the old man and the old woman you will go with him. Be a supreme marksman, the sniper of all snipers, with this Bible: cast down imaginations and subdue yourself with it.

Many do not hate the world; they hate having to change, repent, get their minds right and come back to the heavenly Father. “No man can serve two masters: for either he will hate the one, and love the other”: you will have enmity against God and love money, your career, your bed, the Christmas stocking full of abominations. Many snuck off to celebrate the slaughter of their brothers, the tribe of Gad, with a turkey drumstick and the football game, then came back saying shalom.

“Or else he will hold to the one, and despise the other.” A decision has to be made; many hold to the world and despise the heavenly Father. “Ye cannot serve God and mammon”: the God of the nation of Israel and money. Brothers are more loyal to their jobs and the white man who runs these corporations, who can terminate your contract. Fifteen years, excellent performance, promotions, getting ready to retire, and a white boy pulls the plug on your ass. You were loyal to that damn demon for fifteen years. Meanwhile you were the brother who missed the Sabbaths, never asked for the day off, couldn’t make it to camp, but could be there for that Edomite. One man gave 21 years to McDonald’s and they gave him a Huffy bicycle.

You can go to college and have a degree: go learn what your enemies learn and bring it back to elevate your people, not to serve them. We must work; this is a curse we caused to fall upon us. Don’t get comfortable with the curse. Use the world without abusing it, support this truth and your family, and get back home among like-minded brothers and sisters. Do not sell your soul for this. Give your all to the heavenly Father, keep his commandments, be sincere, and the Lord will elevate you in due time.

How do we purify our minds? “That he might sanctify and cleanse it with the washing of water by the word.” Christianity thinks dipping in water makes you a whole new person, but the true baptism is washing yourself with the word, as we are doing right now in this class.

To be sanctified and cleansed by the washing of water by the word means you must keep the commandments. That is how you cleanse yourself and purify your heart.

“The law of the Lord is perfect, converting the soul: the testimony of the Lord is sure, making wise the simple.” The law of the Lord is what cleanses you and makes you perfect. Keeping the commandments is the cleansing that purifies the heart of the double minded.

sense.text: “For what shall it profit a man, if he shall gain the whole world”: that is the question to those who love the world. “And lose his own soul?” He was so lustful and covetous over the petty things this world provides that he loses his soul: he does not get the kingdom. What is the profit in having enmity against the Lord and losing your soul because you would rather further this kingdom than the Lord’s? The train keeps rolling whether you are here or not; the Lord is not worried about numbers, and his will is already written out. You had a gazillion dollars, lived comfortable here, and could not pay your way into the kingdom of heaven. You lost it all at the end.
“Or what shall a man give in exchange for his soul?” You can’t pay to get the kingdom.

“Whosoever therefore shall be ashamed of me”: that is Christ, “and of my words”, because Christ is the word made flesh, and you read about him in here. You are ashamed of his words when you won’t pick up your Bible and read four chapters, or the precept packet to learn to move this weapon. You are ashamed that Christ, the ultimate physician, has the fix for you.

“In this adulterous and sinful generation”: those who love this world are adulterers in the eyesight of the Lord. “Of him also shall the Son of man be ashamed, when he cometh in the glory of his Father with the holy angels.” Christ will say, I never knew you. I was at every tabernacle, I bought the garments, I wore fringes, I stood post at camp. Yes, but you denied my words, made a show before men and at home did not do what I commanded. You never killed the old man; you put on a mask for the day and went back to your filth.

A negro says all I want is a piece of the pie, when the entire planet belongs to us. We are not sharing the pie with these nations: not forty acres and a mule but hectares of land and the heathen underneath our feet, cutting their grass with their teeth, and when it grows back, getting their monkey ass out there to cut it again; keeping their heads down before the captains, the Bishop and the angels. After a thousand years they serve and are put to death. That is what the Bible says, and settling for a piece of the pie is being ashamed of his words.

precepts.why:
Those ashamed of his words are ashamed of the one named here. “For unto us a child is born, unto us a son is given”: that child is Christ, and this goes into his titles. “And the government shall be upon his shoulder: and his name shall be called Wonderful, Counsellor.”

Christ is the ultimate Counsellor. The counsel for everything you are dealing with in this world and this captivity is already here, and many despise it. You can’t get this counsel on a white man’s couch, or from Maury Povich and Dr. Phil; those demons destroy homes. This Counsellor charges you nothing. Black people love free stuff, but when Christ gives it free you deny it.

People purposely avoid the counsellors here because they have itching ears, seeking counsel from those just as new as they are, so they don’t have to hear: fix your house, stop watching porn, delete the apps, get a flip phone, stop hanging with the same folks who led you into the same judgments. They still have the hooks of Satan in them. They bypass the counsel, but they are there for the drinks, the mirth, the laughter and the jokes all day long.

sense.text:
“That ye put off concerning the former conversation the old man”: eliminate the conversation and mindset of the old carnal, sinful man: football, boxing, how many women I can get, how much weed I smoke, how many fifths I can drink, I’m a player, I’m a pimp. You must literally learn to speak all over again. Many can laugh about a comedian or the world, but the second the scriptures come up they hang up; they can’t hold a conversation in the scriptures and back closer and closer to the door.

Your allegiance comes out in your conversation, your mannerisms and what you do in your leisure time. Invest in Facebook and Instagram instead of righteousness, and among the children of the light your darkness shows; you feel guilty, fade to the back and leave early with excuses.

“Which is corrupt”: that mentality is filthy in the eyesight of the Lord and manifests all the time. “According to the deceitful lusts”: the ways of this world are hooks in your spirit that will take your soul out of the game.

“And be renewed in the spirit of your mind”: by the scriptures. There must be change. The old man must be killed. If you are still the same three or four years in this truth, brothers and sisters, examine yourself; something is not right.

“And that ye put on the new man, which after God is created in righteousness and true holiness.” If you are the same as when you came through the door, you have not killed the old man and you are waiting to be killed. Put on the king that you are, the god that you are. Sisters, put on the attributes of your foremothers and show yourselves daughters of Sarah. We are the greatest people on the face of the earth, but we can’t get over the hump to see it; we think the heathen are the greatest because of what they have, when we invented what they have.

“Wherefore putting away lying”: many brothers have a lying mouth; they will watch you make fruit punch Kool-Aid and tell you it was blueberry, tell one brother they are doing all right and another they don’t feel good. “Speak every man truth with his neighbour”: that is hard for many, even with a brother battling the same thing. Pride keeps a brother from telling a brother what he is going through. How can we gather ourselves together, O nation not desired, when we can’t talk to each other about our situations?

Pride is the final seal. Once pride attaches to the sin you neglected to overcome, you are sealed in your ways. You may start with lust, a simple sin you could fast and pray off, but these spirits multiply if you don’t get them off you, and once pride comes you can’t see your sin any more, you make excuses for it, and you walk around covered in thorns where nobody can help or fix you.

Keep coming back to it: since the beginning of the class it has been the truth, and the truth shall make you free. That is what gets you out of the condition you are in. The Bible keeps referencing back and forth; Christ doesn’t change. He tells you many ways, but it is we who don’t apply what he says.

“For we are members one of another.” All we got is us, Israel. The other nations don’t give a damn about us.

“Be ye angry, and sin not: let not the sun go down upon your wrath”: don’t let wisdom cease among you. “Neither give place to the devil.” In wrath brothers lose the common courtesy and sense to apply God’s laws and deal harshly with one another. Retain wisdom by the laws of God: study, pray and apply, as the Bishop says. We are at war internally and externally, and many can’t grasp the butter coming out from leadership because of the war still inside them; they hear only the salute at the start and the closing words at the end.

“Let him that stole steal no more”: stealing, boosting, scamming, tax evasion. Those who want to be Moors with fezzes had better pay their taxes or get taxed. “But rather let him labour, working with his hands the thing which is good, that he may have to give to him that needeth.” Get a job; we all have to support. When the Lord blesses a brother with a great job, it is not just for him; it is to help the body. What is the purpose of a five- or six-bedroom house when you see a proven brother in need and say be warm and filled? Still prove them, and put everything in writing, so you don’t get burned.

“Let no corrupt communication proceed out of your mouth, but that which is good to the use of edifying, that it may minister grace unto the hearers.” The Bishop told of an elder you couldn’t call to chit-chat about who won the fight; you had better be asking a scriptural question or he would dismiss you off the phone. His communication was to build up the hearer. You can see how a brother is doing, but the chit-chat about the world, about your favorite basketball player back in the day, is a waste of time. We are at war; condition your minds to it.

“And grieve not the holy Spirit of God”: the laws, the spirit of God within you. Let your tongue be seasoned with salt and always bring forth edification; even a simple shalom, how you doing, the Most High and Christ bless you, because you never know what a brother or sister is going through.

“Whereby ye are sealed unto the day of redemption.” By applying these things you are sealed. As Bishop Kennai says, you have the crown; just don’t let anybody take it. Many cast their crown away because they like this wicked world.

precepts.why:
“Repent ye therefore, and be converted.” There is a difference. To repent is to stop your sin, stop breaking the laws of God. To be converted is the actions behind it: a pattern of righteousness and good works to follow, so you are not dabbling in your old sin. You used to lie and steal; now you speak uprightly to your brothers. You used to not work; now you are working, because you need a provision not for yourself and your family only but for the nation that depends on you.

That pattern of good works following repentance shows you truly repented and are no longer that old man or that old woman. That is what it is to be renewed in the spirit of your mind.

sense.text:
The chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff speaks of American combat power in our own neighborhood, not overseas, and they speak of waging war on politically incorrect thoughts, with a list of those they count a danger: the Proud Boys, the Nation of Islam, and Israel United in Christ at number three. Who have we killed, shot or lynched? Where is the KKK on that list? We are listed for teaching the word of God: against the gays, against the image of Cesare Borgia as Christ, in a Christian nation that cannot refute what comes out of this Bible. They are not coming for the left; they are coming for the nation of Israel, for the prophets, as they did our brothers in France. Esau the dragon’s ultimate weapon is communication, spewing his venom across every corner through social media, and we are a danger because we use that same weapon against him, as David did against Goliath, fighting evil with the good. Deacon Malachi says to watch and observe the time here and overseas.

“Yea, truth faileth; and he that departeth from evil maketh himself a prey.” Those who depart from evil, keep the laws of God, repent and come back have made themselves a prey and a target of the other nations. The second you said, I believe this, I broke bread, I’m affiliated, you became a target. They have your face, your social media, where you work and the car you drive; you can’t run.

When it hits the fan many will bounce and say they were never with those guys in purple, but Esau hates a traitor; he will use you and then kill you. Take your death manfully and cheerfully; we will be back. Christ showed how to sacrifice yourself for your nation, and we are to be miniature carbon copies of Christ. Better to be put to death doing the Father’s will than to have enmity against him, because that death is worse; it is not over when you are freed from the shell, you still give account in that day. We all agreed to that lot. Fulfill your course and don’t fall out.

Those who don’t turn and are comfortable here in this simple ass world have earned their citizenship in this demonic system and will burn here as citizens. Rather have the target on your back: our citizenship is in the kingdom.

“Surely oppression maketh a wise man mad.” Does seeing your brothers and sisters in bondage in captivity not make you men mad?

“And a gift destroyeth the heart.” They give you the top-of-the-line jobs so you don’t feel oppressed. As in the movie Trick Baby, get hold of those with the smarts and education first so they don’t go back and cause an uprising: give them gifts, good jobs, the desires of their heart, so they never go back to heal their communities.

Now the gift is being taken away. Trump says, I’m doing away with all of that, I’m going to press the hell out of y’all niggas. He revoked Executive Order 11246, signed by Lyndon B. Johnson in 1965, which required federal contractors to take affirmative action, along with the other DEI orders. The independent, highly educated sister with the good job has to go too; they don’t want you in that seat, as was said of a black pilot, hopefully he has the credentials. Many have been fired behind it. They loved the world and received the gift, and, as John Witherspoon said, their pleasure was serving the white man: the white man been good to me, boss. Now the demon has wiped it away.

That is the beginning stage: the education, the money, the good paying job, until you are fully invested in Esau’s kingdom and he has all the hooks. We’re not racist, we gave you a good job, you bought your mom a house. So you are blinded to the oppression and don’t see what your nation is going through, until Satan says it is go time and the Lord shows the people the true oppression. Now that you see he has fangs, what are you going to do? The devil gave you his blessing, as he tempted Christ: all this will I give you if you bow down and worship me. Many have denied the Lord and become full-blown Satanists.
“Finally, my brethren, be strong in the Lord, and in the power of his might.” Brothers say it real good after class, but there is more to it. How do we become strong in the Lord?

“Put on the whole armour of God”: study the Bible. “That ye may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil”: the tricks, the doctrines and the deceitfulness of the deceiver. You must study to be girded up, armor-clad with the Bible and the commandments.

“For we wrestle not against flesh and blood”: there is a whole system. “But against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world, against spiritual wickedness in high places.” These demons have conversations about us. It is a war, and that is why you must execute the man in you, to have the clarity to see the conniving, deceitful, envious, jealous, hateful, murderous spirit of these other nations against our people.

Your job is to perform this. “I protest by your rejoicing which I have in Christ Jesus our Lord, I die daily.” Paul put himself out there, did the work, and killed the old man daily. You must kill that old man daily. Did Paul just sit on his ass? How did he die daily?

precepts.why:
“If any man will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross daily, and follow me.” That is how Paul died daily. We are all commanded to take up our cross and die daily.

To take up your cross is to accept your death when it comes. Kill the old man, and take your death if they take you out. We will be back. 12 tribes.
